title: Hunt the synthetic method
prompt:
Implement `static java.util.function.Comparator<String> lambdaComparator()` that returns a comparator built from a **lambda** (e.g. `(a, b) -> a.length() - b.length()`), and `static boolean hasSyntheticMember()` that reflects over `Solution.class.getDeclaredMethods()` and returns true iff at least one method `isSynthetic()` (the lambda's desugared helper).
Also implement `static java.util.function.Comparator<String> anonymousComparator()` using an **anonymous inner class** — anonymous classes do not add synthetic *methods* to Solution.
The tests verify both the sorting behavior and the reflective difference.

tests.name: lambda comparator sorts
lambda leaves a synthetic trace
tests.code: checkTrue(Solution.hasSyntheticMember(), "lambda desugars to a synthetic method");
tests.hint: Reflect over getDeclaredMethods and look for isSynthetic().

tests.name: anonymous comparator works too
